title: About Us — Baker Road Baptist Church, Baytown TX
metaDescription: Our mission, what we believe, the history of Baker Road, and the people who serve at Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown, Texas.
headline: Who we are, and what we are for.

sections.heading: Make disciples
sections.body: The mission of Baker Road Baptist Church is the mission Jesus gave his followers: go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.

sections.heading: A city changed
sections.body: To be a community of authentic believers, and to see Baytown transformed by the reality of the gospel as people come to know Jesus as Lord and Savior.
sections.note: “Go, therefore, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age.” — Matthew 28:19–20, CSB

sections.heading: Our core convictions
sections.body: Everything we teach and every ministry we run grows out of these. This is the short form. Ask Pastor Marvin for the long one.

items.title: God
items.body: One eternally existing God in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Creator of everything visible and invisible, perfect in love, holiness, justice, and mercy, and unchanging.

items.title: Revelation
items.body: God has made himself known through his Son Jesus Christ, who is the visible image of the invisible God, through the Holy Scriptures, and through creation itself.

items.title: Mankind
items.body: People, male and female, were made in God's image and for his glory. The first humans were created without sin and given the care of creation.

items.title: The Fall
items.body: When Adam and Eve disobeyed God they became distorted images of him, fell out of fellowship with him, and fractured all of creation with them.

items.title: The Church
items.body: The church is meant to be the visible body of Christ, sent into the world to glorify God and proclaim the gospel of Jesus Christ.

items.title: Resurrection
items.body: Jesus Christ is returning to judge the living and the dead and to bring the fullness of God's kingdom on earth.

sections.heading: On Baker Road since 1978
sections.body: We started as a mission of Memorial Baptist Church with thirteen families meeting in an elementary school cafeteria. The building came later.

items.title: The land
items.body: Memorial Baptist Church, under Rev. A. L. Jordan, buys land on Baker Road in Baytown.

items.title: Thirteen charter families
items.body: The new mission launches. The first service meets at Pumphrey Elementary School, with Memorial's pastor Dr. Ed Thiele preaching and charter member Woody Harrison leading the music.

items.title: Rev. David B. Davis, first pastor
items.body: The mission takes the name Baker Road Baptist Mission and starts a bus ministry that brings sixty children and adults to Sunday School, plus a radio ministry on KBUK.

items.title: Dr. Burt Purvis, second pastor
items.body: Baker Road becomes the fastest growing Southern Baptist church in Texas in 1980 and 1981. Members lay the sanctuary carpet overnight so the new building can open on schedule.

items.title: The first service at 900 West Baker Road
items.body: Built together with Memorial Baptist members in a “Let's Build It Now” effort. An education building follows in 1982.

items.title: Constituted as a church
items.body: No longer Baker Road Mission. From here on, Baker Road Baptist Church.

items.title: Dr. Pete Freeman, third pastor
items.body: A graduate of East Texas Baptist College and Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary.

items.title: Pastor Marvin Rose
items.body: Called on January 2, 1994, and still preaching here today.

sections.imageAlt: The Baker Road Baptist Church building not long after it opened, in black and white, with cars from the period parked outside

items.title: Marvin Rose
items.body: Pastor Marvin has led Baker Road since January 1994. He holds a Master of Divinity from New Orleans Baptist Theological Seminary and served ten years on its Board of Trustees. Before Baytown he pastored First Baptist Church in Saluda, North Carolina. He preaches expository sermons. He and his wife Melinda are married.

items.title: Sarah Joy McClain
items.body: Sarah Joy joined the church as Worship Leader in May 2020. She holds a music degree from East Texas Baptist University and has taught at Baytown Christian Academy and Lamar Elementary.

items.title: Viola Johnson
items.body: Viola leads the Child Care ministry and serves in student ministry, holding the church to its standards of faith, safety, and professionalism.

sections.heading: Serving alongside the pastor
sections.body: A body of called men who serve alongside the pastor in meeting the spiritual needs of this congregation.

items.title: Alan Barber
items.body: Formerly on staff as Youth Minister and Associate Pastor.

items.title: Gil Johnston
items.body: Serves alongside his wife Vivian.
